compiled_state.description:
## Completed outcome

Merged commit `586357b70996537ac790a82da56fe6e372d0d3e5` implements a rollback-safe,
durable bridge pause/resume surface while preserving old readers, old reconcile vocabulary, and
existing workflow/environment behavior.

The remote `refs/reconciler/gate` blob remains dual-format:
`gated_mode: "reconcile-check"` plus `paused`, `reason`, `who`, and `paused_at`.
Pause provenance uses repository `git user.email` and first-pause UTC RFC3339 time. Same-reason
pause is idempotent and preserves metadata; different reason, blank reason, missing identity,
missing remote, and CAS movement refuse without overwrite. Resume deletes only the observed ref
OID and can recover a corrupt blob without decoding it.

A new pause blocks before pass-lock acquisition or ticket mutation and returns rc 0 with one exact,
anchored, JSON-decoded `BRIDGE_PAUSED:` line. The scheduled workflow recognizes only that complete
rc-0 marker and skips commit-and-push. Ordinary rc 0, malformed/unanchored markers, corrupt rc 1,
and legacy gate rc 4 retain their existing behavior. The pre-gate `reconcile-check` early return
and old `rebar reconcile --mode` vocabulary remain functional.

## Authoritative evidence

- Gerrit 1549: `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, zero unresolved comments, merged as
  `586357b709`; retry CI run 31272528686 completed 15/15 jobs successfully.
- Held-out affected oracle: 82/82 green. Final pre-push affected/module-size oracle: 86/86 green.
- Static gates: lint, Ruff format, actionlint, complexity, typecheck, config-check, generated CLI
  reference, module-size, and diff checks green.
- Mutation teeth: tests went RED when additive `gated_mode` was removed, marker anchoring was
  weakened, and corrupt-gate traceback handling was regressed; production was restored after each.
- Primary contract tests:
  `tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py`,
  `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_main.py`,
  `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock_ref_backend.py`,
  `tests/unit/workflow/test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py`, and
  `tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py`.
- Implementation/docs:
  `src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py`,
  `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_ref_lock.py`,
  `_advisory_lock.py`, `__main__.py`,
  `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`, CLI help/reference, user guide, exit codes, and release
  notes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The durable operator contract is complete and rollback-safe: every pause blob retains
      `gated_mode: reconcile-check` plus `paused/reason/who/paused_at`; the pre-change decoder
      accepts it; repository git email and first-pause RFC3339 provenance are enforced; blank,
      missing-identity, missing-remote, different-reason, and CAS-conflict cases refuse without
      overwrite; same-reason pause is metadata-stable; resume is observed-OID CAS and clears absent,
      valid, or corrupt state safely. Proof:
      `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_ref_lock.py`,
      `src/rebar/_cli/_bridge_commands.py`, and
      `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock_ref_backend.py`.
- [x] Runtime and workflow behavior is complete without regressions: pause and corrupt-gate paths
      return before lock/pass/ticket mutation; pause emits only the exact anchored four-key rc-0
      `BRIDGE_PAUSED` line and skips scheduled commit-and-push; corrupt state emits the exact rc-1
      recovery line without traceback and is repaired by resume; ordinary success, malformed or
      unanchored markers, legacy gate rc 4, benign/generic mappings, old `rebar reconcile --mode`,
      and the pre-gate `reconcile-check` return remain functional. Proof:
      `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py`,
      `.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`,
      `tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py`,
      `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_main.py`, and
      `tests/unit/workflow/test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py`.
- [x] The staged public contract and exclusions are complete: CLI help, generated reference, user
      guide, exit-code docs, and release notes expose `preview/sync/pause/resume`; no `--until`,
      automatic expiry, new-only blob, gate rename, or old-vocabulary removal shipped. Proof:
      `src/rebar/_cli/help/bridge.txt`, `src/rebar/_cli/help/overview.txt`,
      `docs/cli-reference.md`, `docs/user-guide.md`, `docs/exit-codes.md`,
      `docs/release-notes.md`, and `tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py`.

## Residual disposition

MCP and library pause/resume parity is filed in existing dependent story
`f789-3f9d-8b35-4e0d`. Near-cap `_ref_lock.py` restructuring remains owned by
`5e53-234f-5c65-477d` and is linked to this story. No test exclusion or weaker validation remains.
## Verification

- Checked: `rtk pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/test_advisory_lock_ref_backend.py tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_reconcile_main.py tests/unit/workflow/test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py`.
- Checked: `rtk pytest tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py tests/unit/test_gen_cli_reference.py`.
- Checked: `rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`, `rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`, generated-reference freshness, module-size, config, and diff gates.
